notes: Cheats disable trophies and saving, so keep them off for the whole run.
The Irredeemable criminal profile is permanent and makes the police far more aggressive, so avoid excessive violence if you care about that.
No trophy needs a difficulty setting, a mission medal or any online play: the game has no difficulty settings, no mission medals and no online trophies.
Only the items marked as full sets need everything: robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's Target Decks. The rest accept a partial total.

steps.body: Five chapters and 91 missions. The chapter trophies and the named-mission trophies land here in order, starting with Gone Fishing. Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app and study animals with binoculars as you go: 200 vehicle scans and 100 animal studies are needed later. Take optional missions and character questlines as they appear, since many are only offered for a while. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter: there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, and the game gives 15 manual save slots plus one autosave.
steps.title: Step 1 — Play the story
steps.warning: CHAPTER 1 WARNING — after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia may go to the balcony at Jason's house to meditate. Talk to her in the kitchen in the morning, follow her out and accept. That moment disappears after Chapter 1, and it may be required for Positive Mental Attitude, the one possibly missable trophy. It is still unclear whether it counts, so do it and keep a chapter-start save.

steps.body: After the credits, the checklist appears under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. It has 35 requirements, and most ask for only part of a set, so it is closer to 60% true completion. Only the robberies, the underwater discoveries, the shooting-range golds, the drone races and Bret's Target Decks demand everything. Nothing on it is missable, and progress made during the story already counts. Most of the grind trophies land here or alongside it: 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 42 shooting-range golds and the fencing totals. A Long Road, the gold 100% trophy, is the last big gate and the hardest trophy by both guides' judgement.
steps.title: Step 2 — The 100% checklist

steps.body: The 8 stranger strands are not part of the 100% checklist, so they are finished here, along with any character questlines still open and any miscellaneous trophies left over. Everything in this step stays available in free roam after the story. The one trophy whose method is still unconfirmed, Bad Luck, I Guess, belongs here too: check the guides again before you chase it.
